note: Keep webpack out of the declarations `@devup-ui/next-plugin` publishes. `restoreSessionState` was typed through the internal engine loader, which pulled `@devup-ui/webpack-plugin` and webpack's own types (ajv, enhanced-resolve, schema-utils and more, 72 files) into the type check of every app whose `next.config.ts` imports the plugin. Next's type check now reads 72 fewer files and its `.next/cache/.tsbuildinfo` is about 26 KB smaller. The public API is unchanged.
